initialExam.title: SSC CHSL 2026
initialExam.description: Combined Higher Secondary Level exam for LDC, JSA, Postal Assistant, Sorting Assistant, and DEO posts. Notification expected June 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: 12th Standard pass from a recognized Board
initialExam.syllabus: Tier-I: General Intelligence (25Q), English Language (25Q), Quantitative Aptitude (25Q), General Awareness (25Q). Tier-II: Math, Reasoning, English, GK + Typing/Data Entry skill test.
initialExam.examPattern: Tier-I: 100 questions, 200 marks, 60 min. Tier-II: 120 questions, 360 marks, 2 hours + Skill Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Tier-I (CBT) → Tier-II (CBT + Skill Test) → Document Verification
initialExam.jobRole: Lower Division Clerk, Postal Assistant, Sorting Assistant, Data Entry Operator
initialExam.careerGrowth: LDC → UDC → Assistant → Section Officer through departmental exams.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ssc.gov.in 2. Register/Login 3. Fill application 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical Benefits, Pension

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
